Elsewhere Pep Guardiola has gone on the record about the verdict on City's charges, Arsenal apparently travel fewer air miles than City in the title run-in, and two Arsenal youngsters made their England youth debuts. On transfers, file Viktor Gyokeres explaining his stance on a summer sale and Muzzi's old tale of turning down Wenger firmly under "Rumour"; there's no "Here we go" anywhere today, so nobody panic and nobody celebrate.
